full_judgment: "The learned Senior Advocate for the petitioners submits that the plaintiffs having been able to seek further relief by way of partition and recovery of Khas possession than a mere declaration of title, omitted to do so, the suit is barred under section 42 of the Specific Relief Act, which the High Court Division failed to consider and thereby committed serious error of 1 law in reversing the concurrent decision of the courts below, resulting in failure of justice."
